notes.title: Elsie v1.1.2! Patch rolling out now!
notes.notes:
Sup folks! 

First of all, thank you for bearing with us while the Knight Shift team ensured their safety last month during hurricane Milton, they've since been hard at work taking on a bunch of your feedback and making tweaks to improve the Elsie experience! A patch is rolling out now to address a number of issues and bring about some balance changes, please take a look at the patch notes below!

Elsie v1.1.2

[u]Gameplay Changes[/u]

- Changed the pacing of how some lines of dialogue appear during the final boss cutscene to make more sense
- Fixing a run on act 3 will no longer auto-teleport you into the Wharf. You'll get a chance to collect all the items and take the teleporter back home
- Speedrun achievement now requires the true victory
- Credits are now skippable
- Heart Fragments can now drop from normal chests and rarely on enemy kills
- Andru is at the Wharf from the start of the game
- Jacky's vault is unlockable and viewable stats at the Wharf
- Should be able to gain enough XP to reach level 10 by killing enough enemies by end of game

[u]Balance changes[/u]

- Chalice nerfed from 10% to 5% bit gain
- Deep Pockets nerfed from 50% to 35% bit gain
- Collector nerfed from 10% to 5% of bits converted into damage
- Pickpocket nerfed from gaining 50 bits to 15 bits
- Celestia's base health decreased by 20%
- Removed ability for normal chests from dropping bits
- XP Gain now increased by 5% per Heat Level
- Chain Lightning Dmg Scaling increased from 35% to 85% (of your combined damage + spell damage)
- Burning Scaling increased from 25% to 65% (of your combined damage + spell damage)
- Firefly Damage increased from 22.5 to 30
- Drone Damage scaling increased from 25% of weapon damage to 50% of weapon damage
- Starting max drone count increased from 3 to 4
- Scattershot damage reduction reduced from 45% to 40%
- Dubious Pen to destroy a chest reward from 50% to 25%
- Lightning Walls should no longer deal damage to you if you have Gaia Armament
- Guardian Trigger no longer causes Elsie to take more damage
- Guardian Trigger charge up on enemy kill reduced from 8% to 5%
- Counterattack Damage increased from 50 to 80

[u]Bug Fixes[/u]

- Boomerang bullets should deal damage on return
- Chests will no longer drop "nothing" or small amounts of bits
- Fixed text on many items
- Fixed soft-locks on boss fights
- NPC chatter is gone after unlocking in the stage
- Fixed issue where normal chests were not dropping spell damage increases
- Fixed issues with parry and meal ticket achievements unlocking all at once

And that's not all! Elsie is also up for THREE awards over the next few weeks, Elsie has been shortlisted for a GWB Award on the 22nd of November, Best Arcade Game at the TIGA Awards on November 28th and for commitments to Accessibility at The Indie Game Awards on December 19th! 

We're so honoured to see the game nominated among so many incredible games that came out this year!

Thank you once again to everyone who has played Elsie and provided feedback! Keep it coming as the Knight Shift team continue to tweak and look to the future of the game! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1515570/Elsie/

notes.title: Elsie | Dev Team Update
notes.notes:
Sup folks!

As it's been a few weeks since the first Elsie patch, I wanted to give you guys a quick update on where the dev team are at with the next patch!

The Knight Shift team have been working on what's coming next for Elsie, however, as they're based in Florida, they're currently taking precautions to protect themselves in the face of Hurricane Milton. 

With this in mind, the next patch for Elsie may be affected by internet or power outages, or just generally by the team taking the time to ensure their safety. Naturally this is our priority and we'll provide more details on the next patch as soon as we're sure everyone can work safely and securely!

For anyone else within the community that's in the Florida area/path of Hurricane Milton, we extend our well wishes. Please be safe!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1515570/Elsie/

notes.title: Elsie - Small patch rolling out now!
notes.notes:
Sup folks,

A big thank you to everyone who has picked up Elsie over the last week, and also to everyone who has been leaving constructive feedback in the forums since launch! Your feedback has helped give the devs a good idea of what to look at, while they're investigating some other things, here's a quick rundown on what to expect from the first patch dropping today!

Currently this update is only applies to Steam, we'll share more details for other platforms when applicable!

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where bouncy bullets and piercing bullets would hit more times than intended
[*] Stopped Saws and Dodders enemies spawning an audio event per frame
[*] Fixed issue with Drones attacking at the same rate as Elsie
[*] Charge weapons no longer keep spawning infinite charging VFX
[*] Camera transitions between rooms should no longer lag behind
[*] Jacky's chatter no longer persists after unlocking her
[*] Tuxedo item description fixed to show correct values
[*] Spellmaster item description updated
[*] Helix augment description updated
[*] Fixed soft-lock when attempting to level up when leaving a challenge room
[*] Fixed soft-lock when opening menu during boss transitions
[/list]
Gameplay:
[list]
[*] After defeating a boss, they will no longer appear until after you've defeated the Guardian of that world
[*] Reduced bonus damage gained from Damage Up drops
[*] Armor Plating reduced from 5 to 3  
[*] Reduced Unload's attack speed increase per bullet from 5% to 3%
[*] Enemies now scale harder over multiple runs
[/list]
Once again, thanks to everyone for trying Elsie and taking the time to share feedback! This isn't all the team are working on, and we'll have more news for you soon! [url=discord.gg/ksg]Jump in the Knight Shift Games Discord[/url] to provide your feedback directly to the devs or pop it in the Steam forums!
